coverage.visual_method: EVERY frame decoded (native fps, gray low-res) for change detection; one representative full-res frame per state reviewed on labelled contact sheets (not every frame viewed)
coverage.audio_method: Whole soundtrack analysed by signal processing (loudness/pauses/transient flux) and spectrogram strips inspected; NOT auditory listening

caveats: ASR transcript is machine output (Whisper base): proper nouns and some numbers are unverified; on-screen text is the better source where visible.
Pixel-difference thresholds cannot see changes confined to <0.03% of pixels; 'MICRO_CHANGE' episodes are counted but not tabulated.
Easing cannot be distinguished from linear motion with this evidence; recorded as NOT_ASSESSED.
Audio: no listening panel; 'music' and 'SFX' claims are limited to what spectrograms and measured loudness show.
financial_claims_qa: 39 unique claims with valid sentence-derived intervals; financial truth not independently verified
targeted_motion_qa: See07_VALIDATION/FINAL_EVIDENCE_QA_2026-10-12.json; narrow sequence review only, full AV pending

independent_motion_review.scope: Nine source samples per candidate at native-frame-adjacent start and distributed follow-on points; not continuous playback
